```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.ent" NDATA png>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment spanning parser edge cases -->
  <?target processing-instruction-data attribute="value"?>
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities;, and <!-- comments --> inside ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE test [
  <!ELEMENT test (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % inner "<!ENTITY deep 'nested-replacement'>">
  %inner;
  <!ENTITY base "&deep; and more">
]>
<test xmlns="urn:test" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment before PI -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <node>
    <![CDATA[
      Another CDATA block testing parsing boundaries.
    ]]>
    &base;
  </node>
</test>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA | item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Data 1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Data 2 &ent1;">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<doc xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/doc/" xmlns:ns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ns/">
  <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
  <!-- Document comment block -->
  <ns:item>
    <![CDATA[
      <ns:tag>CDATA content with markup-like strings</ns:tag>
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </ns:item>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %dtd-ext;
  <!ENTITY publisher "O'Reilly & Associates">
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://bookstore.org/ns" xmlns:p="http://bookstore.org/ns/prices">
  <?catalog-info version="1.0"?>
  <!-- This is a comment inside the catalog root -->
  <book>
    <title>XML Parsing Strategies</title>
    <author>&publisher;</author>
    <![CDATA[
      Free-form text block inside CDATA with unescaped < > & " ' characters.
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (paragraph*)>
  <!ELEMENT paragraph (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-acute "é">
  <!ENTITY sample "Caf&e-acute;">
  <!ENTITY % ext-entity SYSTEM "internal.ent">
  %ext-entity;
]>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
  <!-- Multi-line 
       XML Comment 
       with rare construct focus -->
  <section>
    <paragraph>
      <![CDATA[
        Strict CDATA block: no parsing of entities like &sample; here.
      ]]>
      Real entity usage: &sample;
    </paragraph>
  </section>
</document>
```
